intro a ha
have h_all : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℤ), (∀ n, f n = 1 ∨ f n = -1) → ∀ (d : ℕ), ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (m i : ℕ), i < d → |∑ j ∈ range m, f (a i j)| ≤ (C : ℤ) := by
  intro f hf d
  use 1
  intro m i hi
  by_cases hpos : (∑ j ∈ range m, f (a i j) : ℤ) ≥ 0
  · have h1 : (∑ j ∈ range m, f (a i j) : ℤ) ≤ (m : ℤ) := by
      have h2 : ∀ (j : ℕ), j ∈ Finset.range m → f (a i j) ≤ 1 := by
        intro j hj
        have h3 : f (a i j) = 1 ∨ f (a i j) = -1 := hf (a i j)
        cases h3 with
        | inl h3 => rw [h3]
        | inr h3 => rw [h3]; linarith
      have h4 : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, f (a i j) : ℤ) ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (1 : ℤ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j hj
        exact h2 j hj
      have h5 : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (1 : ℤ) : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) := by simp [Finset.sum_const]
      rw [h5] at h4
      exact h4
    have h6 : |(∑ j ∈ range m, f (a i j) : ℤ)| = (∑ j ∈ range m, f (a i j) : ℤ) := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hpos]
    rw [h6]
    linarith
  · have h1 : (∑ j ∈ range m, f (a i j) : ℤ) ≥ (-(m : ℤ)) := by
      have h2 : ∀ (j : ℕ), j ∈ Finset.range m → -1 ≤ f (a i j) := by
        intro j hj
        have h3 : f (a i j) = 1 ∨ f (a i j) = -1 := hf (a i j)
        cases h3 with
        | inl h3 => rw [h3]; linarith
        | inr h3 => rw [h3]
      have h4 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (-1 : ℤ) ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, f (a i j) : ℤ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j hj
        exact h2 j hj
      have h5 : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (-1 : ℤ) : ℤ) = (-(m : ℤ)) := by
        have h6 : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (-1 : ℤ) : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) * (-1 : ℤ) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
          <;> simp
        rw [h6]
        ring
      rw [h5] at h4
      exact h4
    have h6 : |(∑ j ∈ range m, f (a i j) : ℤ)| = (-(∑ j ∈ range m, f (a i j) : ℤ)) := by
      rw [abs_of_nonpos]
      linarith
    rw [h6]
    linarith
exact ⟨fun n => 1, fun n => Or.inl rfl, h_all (fun n => 1) (fun n => Or.inl rfl)⟩

/-- Helper: for any finite list of naturals, exists C such that the absolute value
    of the sum of f at those indices (with f = 1) is bounded by C. -/
private theorem helper_bound : ∀ (L : List ℕ), ∃ C : ℕ, (L.map (fun n => (1 : ℤ))).sum ≤ (C : ℤ) := by
  intro L
  use L.length
  have h : (List.map (fun (_ : ℕ) => (1 : ℤ)) L).sum = (L.length : ℤ) := by
    induction L generalizing L with
    | nil => simp
    | cons a L ih =>
      simp [List.map]
      ring_nf
      exact (by omega)
  rw [h]
  exact Int.le_def.mpr (by simp [Int.ofNat_le.mpr])
